title: Error Policies
description: Configure Apollo Client error policies to control how errors and partial data are handled.

data.text: Apollo Client error policies determine whether queries return partial data, throw errors, or ignore errors. The default policy is `none`, which means any GraphQL error causes the query to fail entirely.

items: none: Throw on any GraphQL error (default).
ignore: Ignore errors and return data if available.
all: Return both data and errors for partial data handling.
data.title: Policies
Using error policies
data.content: Receiving partial data with errorPolicy: all.

data.text: Using `errorPolicy: all` requires careful UI design. Users may see incomplete data without knowing something went wrong. Always surface non-critical errors to the user.
data.title: Partial Data UX
Error Policies Key Points
points: all: Return both data and errors.
Choose based on your app's tolerance for partial data.
data.takeaway: Error policies give you control over how Apollo Client handles server-side errors.
